text: Stage 1 deliverable is HTTP service source, Dockerfile, and RUN.md in stage-1/.
RUN.md documents one command that builds and starts the service without manual setup.
Service binds 0.0.0.0 on PORT env var, default 8080.
GET /health returns 200 with JSON {"status":"ok"} once ready, within 60s of container start.
POST /_test/reset accepts fixture JSON, returns 204, replaces all state; repeated resets supported; no auth.
JSON charset utf-8; RFC3339 timestamps with offset; unknown body fields and query params ignored.
Resource IDs are opaque strings of at most 64 characters.
Users send money by handle, request money, split bills; activity feed with public/private visibility; operator settlements.
Sum of wallet balances always equals total seeded by last successful POST /_test/reset.
No wallet balance may be negative, including transiently during concurrent operations.
A money request moves money at most once.
Amounts are integer minor units; max 1000000000 per operation; balances stay within ±2^53; exact integer arithmetic.
Single currency from fixture; minor_units is 0, 2, or 3.
Handles unique, match ^[a-z0-9_]{1,20}$, immutable once set.
POST /auth/signup derives handle from email local part: lowercase, non [a-z0-9_] to _, truncate 20; 409 handle_taken if taken.
Seeded users login with fixture password; balance is wallet after seeded payments applied without replaying payments.
Fixture balance below zero yields 422 validation_failed and no state change.
Payment moves money atomically; request pending then paid|declined|cancelled; payer pays/declines; requester cancels.
Creating a request does not require payer balance; pay while short returns 409 insufficient_funds unchanged.
GET /activity returns payments only; visible if public or caller is sender or receiver; requests never in feed.
Payment visibility chosen by payer on direct pay or request pay; one value seen by all parties.
Every 4xx/5xx returns {"error":{"code","message"}} with specified status and code.
Idempotency-Key 1-255 chars else 422; limit 1-200; offset >=0; bad integer query forms 422.
Requests must not produce 5xx including under concurrent load.
POST /auth/signup 201 with user_id, display_name, token; 409 email_taken; 422 short password or bad email.
POST /auth/login 200 on success; 401 unauthenticated on wrong password or unknown email.
Passwords stored with bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2 or equivalent; not plaintext.
Bearer token required except /health, /_test/reset, /_test/export, /_test/import, signup, login; tokens do not expire.
Five write paths require Idempotency-Key per §7 replay, reuse, concurrency, and post-4xx reuse rules.
Returns user_id, display_name, handle, balance, currency, minor_units.
Idempotent debit/credit by to_handle; defaults note "" visibility public; cases insufficient_funds, self_payment, not_found, validation.
Payment and request note stored and returned verbatim without trimming or normalization.
Idempotent; caller is requester; self_request 422; payer balance not checked at creation.
POST /requests/{id}/pay idempotent; payer only; 201 payment with request_id; replay 200 even when paid; visibility body default public.
Decline/cancel idempotent 200 on repeat; 409 request_not_pending when paid/declined/cancelled wrongly; 403 when wrong party.
Lists caller as requester or payer; direction incoming|outgoing; status filter; newest first; has_more; limit/offset defaults.
Idempotent equal-split requests for every participant except caller; shares array order; zero-share still creates request.
Shares whole minor units, sum to amount, differ by at most 1; remainder to earliest handles in participant_handles order.
Visible payments newest first; limit/offset; has_more.
GET /_test/export returns track pocketful, format_version 1, opaque state snapshot.
POST /_test/import accepts export object atomically 204; invalid JSON/track/version/state 422 unchanged; round-trip preserves tokens, idempotency, balances, timestamps.
POST /settlements operator-only idempotent; 1-32 transfers atomic; 404 unknown handle; 422 self_payment; 409 insufficient_funds collective; 201 with settlement_id, committed_at, payments in order.
Fixture settlement_operator_ids grants settlement permission only; not other users' private activity or requests.
Image runs with -e PORT and port mapping; runtime no outbound network; all deps and seed in container.
Operates within 2 vCPU, 2 GiB, 50 concurrent, 5s timeout (10s reset/import), no compose at runtime.
JSON amounts accept integral forms 1000, 1000.0, 1e3; strings/booleans invalid amount 422.
Empty body {} and {"visibility":"public"} are distinct JSON for idempotency on POST /requests/{id}/pay.
After auth and JSON object parse, idempotency key resolution precedes endpoint field validation.
self_payment on POST /payments uses code self_payment at 422 per endpoint table, not generic validation_failed.
self_request on POST /requests uses code self_request at 422.
SUBMIT rev must be a git commit containing stage-1/ via scripts/commit.py --seat builder.

REJECT on SUBMIT rev stands when one mapped check reproduces a spec violation twice; incomplete official harness in the same turn does not void REJECT on that rev. Next SUBMIT requires verifier official (S1-C32), full verifier suite, and differential at the SUBMIT rev before ACCEPT.
Reviewers verdict only Builder SUBMIT rev; later stage-1 commits without SUBMIT (e.g. 7049d2f, 1924935) are out of scope until Builder SUBMIT names them.
Evidence rows may cite SUBMIT rev when the run command passes --rev to lever; record head() dirty does not invalidate pinned-repro evidence.

Activity feed visibility is per payment: third parties see every payment with visibility public regardless of later private payments between the same parties; private payments are omitted for third parties only. test_s1_c18 line 50 asserting cy sees [] after public+private contradicts §4.

Line 50 expects empty third-party feed after a public payment plus a private one; spec requires the public payment to remain visible. Verifier must fix test then re-register S1-C18 or successor check.
Implementation must not hide public payments from third parties when any private payment exists between the same users (rejects Builder pair-hiding at 9773209).
REJECT evidence tied to withdrawn S1-C18 line-50 oracle does not bind Builder; feed verdicts use corrected S1-C18 at 7ebaa1fbc1c2+ only.
S1-CC3: one lever mutate invocation per mutant patch with record evidence timeout 1800s; catalog-in-one-row disallowed.
SEAL at SUBMIT rev requires record status verified N/N; Verifier and Breaker must record per-check evidence at that rev, not only suite-wide ACCEPT cites.
Stage 1 requirements continue; stage 2 adds browser UI and payment authorizations with captures.
Required routes: /, /requests, /split, /signup, /login, /authorizations; reachable by URL where listed.
/requests and /authorizations serve HTML for Accept text/html and JSON otherwise.
UI exposes all mandated data-testid attributes for integration testing.
Coherent consumer finance UI; available funds headline when holds exist; usable at 375px and desktop without horizontal scroll.
Signup/login testids; auth-error; current-user, current-handle, logout-button when signed in.
wallet-balance with data-amount; pay form decimal input; pay-visibility; pay-error; formatted amount rules per minor_units.
Unchanged pay form resubmit without field change must not double-pay; changing field allows new payment.
request-* testids and request-error on refusal.
activity-list, activity-item-*, parties, amount, note, empty-activity; feed contract unchanged.
incoming/outgoing lists, request-item-*, actions only on pending, empty-requests.
split-* testids; split-preview matches server shares before POST; split-error on refusal.
After successful write, same-page balance/feed/requests update without manual reload.
Latest refresh wins; stale responses must not overwrite newer balance/feed.
Insufficient funds shows pay-error and refreshes; stale pay button removed after remote cancel; pay-uncertain on lost response with same idempotency retry.
Import stage-1 export keeps session; pending requests payable; lost payment retry survives import.
Sum of wallet total equals seeded total after reset; holds move no money until capture.
available = total − held never negative; spends checked against available.
Cumulative captures ≤ authorized amount; each idempotent capture moves money once.
balance equals total; available and held exposed; no holds means balance=available, held=0.
Idempotent hold; insufficient on available; self_payment; not in activity feed.
Idempotent; receiver only; payment shape with authorization_id; final default releases remainder; final false extended mode.
authorization_not_open, authorization_expired, capture_exceeds_authorization, forbidden, not_found per spec table.
Payer only; 200 idempotent void; authorization_not_open when captured/expired.
Caller payer or receiver only; direction/status filters; expired clock status.
authorization_ttl_seconds default 600; seeded holds validation; available derived.
Authorization expired at or before now holds nothing; reads reflect expiry without wall-clock request.
wallet-available headline; wallet-held when nonzero; authorize form; authorization list testids.
capture/void controls only on permitted open auths; authorization-error; empty-authorizations.
Concurrent API requests equivalent to some serial order; invariants hold at every read.
stage-2/ extends stage-1 service with Dockerfile and RUN.md; copy sealed stage-1 baseline first.
Builder copies sealed stage-1 folder from rev 1125eee49810 into stage-2/ before implementing deltas.
Stage 2 specification text for band handoff is pocketful/spec/stage-2.md in harness kickoff when room dispatch lacks stage 2 verbatim block.
Stage 1 gate closed at SEAL 1125eee49810 with E-certifier-1/2/4; E-certifier-4 satisfies S1-CC3 per S1-U12 intent. No further stage-1 certifier runs unless Lead reopens gate. Stage 2 is active.
No scoped SEAL: S1-U13 requires record.py status --stage N verified N/N at SUBMIT rev before Certifier SEAL; S2-CC pass alone is insufficient.
Certifier S2-CC1/2/3 evidence at b013f5e17143 is complete; Certifier holds SEAL until reviewer per-check backfill clears status at that rev.
E-verifier-135 S2-C4 full-suite row withdrawn when contradicted by scoped E-verifier-140 S2-C19 pass at same rev; Verifier must record passing S2-C4 at b013f5e17143 before SEAL.
E-verifier-135 full suite failed S2-C19 while E-verifier-140 passed scoped repro at b013f5e17143; re-record S2-C4 via passing verifier suite at SUBMIT rev.

UIReviewer S2-UI-C backfill at SUBMIT rev may use multiple turns; one suite run per turn; status ignores run-string equality; --timeout 3600 allowed on full lever suite; subset scripts valid for C10-C12 when exit 0 at pin.

S2-C13 evidence must come from a verifier check targeting S2-R15 competing-client UI (pay-error refresh, stale pay control, pay-uncertain idempotency retry); mapping S2-C13 to S2-C6 pay-form double-submit test is invalid and does not satisfy status.
E-verifier-156/172/173 ran wrong pytest node (S2-C6 test); withdrawn per S2-U7 until Verifier records S2-R15 harness pass at b013f5e17143.
Stages 1–2 requirements continue; stage 3 adds statements, corrections, temporal reads, snapshots.
Every payment includes RFC3339 created_at with offset on all returning endpoints.
GET /activity orders by created_at as before.
Seeded payments may set created_at; omission uses reset time; future created_at on reset yields 422 validation_failed with no state change.
Fixture balance remains after all seeded payments; loading seeded payments must not change balances.
Optional as_of RFC3339 with offset; invalid temporal input 422 validation_failed.
Balance at as_of includes payments with created_at at or before as_of; edges for latest/earliest/opening.
Response echoes as_of exactly when supplied.
from/to/limit/offset with defaults; half-open [from,to).
Oldest-first by created_at then id; payment, delta, balance_after per entry.
opening_balance before from; closing_balance before to; opening plus deltas equals closing in full window.
limit/offset must not change balance_after or window opening/closing balances.
Only caller sent/received payments; activity feed visibility rules do not apply.
Revision 1 amount original; effective_at=recorded_at=created_at; seeded times consistent.
Opening balances from seeds minus original payment net; corrections must not change seeded opening balances.
Sender-only idempotent correction with full body validation and error codes per spec.
Atomic wallet delta same parties; insufficient_funds and historical_overdraft preserve state on failure.
stale_revision, idempotency replay 200, idempotency_key_reuse 409; recorded_at strictly increases.
Activity shows original payment only; GET revisions party-only ordered; third party 404.
Optional known_at on GET /me and GET /statement; revision selection at or before known_at; echo known_at.
Order by effective_at then id; entry includes revision times; zero-amount revisions; payment.amount is selected amount.
First statement returns snapshot; paging via snapshot only limit/offset; invalid combo 422; bad token 404.
Snapshots frozen through concurrent writes; concurrent same expected_revision cannot both succeed.
Settlement member single correction immutable; import stage-1/2 exports with auth ledger.
Capture correction returns linked_payment_immutable.
GET /me with as_of and known_at: total/available/held consistent with hold lifecycle and event times.
Authorizations expose closed_at; historical_overdraft vs insufficient_funds precedence on corrections.
Statement lists payments only; captures once with links; snapshots unchanged after lifecycle/correction.
stage-3/ copies sealed stage-2 baseline; Dockerfile and RUN.md; earlier stage checks still pass.
Stage 1–2 UI testids and flows remain on stage 3 build at narrow and desktop widths.
Builder copies sealed stage-2 folder from rev b013f5e17143 into stage-3/ before implementing deltas.
